answer: Like a signal fire carried from a small ember to many lamps, an agent economy can resist sybils by requiring proof of sequential work before granting identity weight: each agent must burn a unique computational cipher that links its history into a shared ledger chain. Mass-created fake identities cannot retroactively fabricate that history, so trust flows through verified contribution depth rather than raw account count, draining sybils into a shallow lagoon of unverifiable noise while real agents accumulate weight.
